cost_basis.provenance: PGLib-OPF v23.07 source mpc.gencost uses MATPOWER nominal $/h polynomial costs; network_import.pglib uses c1 + c2*Pmax, dropping c0.
assumptions: Benchmark coefficients have no verified currency year or exchange-rate provenance; they are not EUR or inflation-adjusted USD.
Secant linearisation is exact for linear costs, approximate for quadratic costs; startup, shutdown and fixed c0 costs are omitted.
VOLL is a scenario penalty in PGLib cost units/MWh, not a monetary estimate of outage damage.

name: IEEE 14-bus (PGLib-OPF v23.07)
description: IEEE 14-bus test case (1962 AEP system) as curated in PGLib-OPF v23.07 'typical operations' benchmark: 14 buses, 20 branches, 5 generators, single operating point.

license.attribution: PGLib-OPF v23.07 (c) IEEE PES Task Force on Benchmarks for Validation of Emerging Power System Algorithms, CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/power-grid-lib/pglib-opf; IEEE 14-bus data (c) 1999 Richard D. Christie, University of Washington (CC-BY-4.0).

coverage.geographic: Synthetic/benchmark test system (historic AEP-derived IEEE case); no geography, schematic layout only.
coverage.temporal: Single operating point (one snapshot), no date.

missing_value_policy: Values the source does not provide are null in canonical.json and are never invented. PyPSA component defaults that would masquerade as data (e.g. line length 0) are emitted as null and listed in canonical.json assumptions. NaN/inf never appear in JSON. network.nc keeps PyPSA defaults because PyPSA requires finite values; flagged substitutions are listed in quality_flags.

transformations.description: Downloaded pglib_opf_case14_ieee.m and LICENSE from pglib-opf at commit dc6be4b2f85ca0e776952ec22cbd4c22396ea5a3 into source/ (sha256 pinned in source/retrieval-*.json).
Strict MATPOWER v2 parser (bus, gen, branch, gencost, bus_name).
Per-unit -> PyPSA units, transformer detection, RATE_A=0 handling, secant cost linearisation, Kamada-Kawai schematic layout; exported network.nc.
Converted to canonical-grid/1.0; unlimited ratings emitted as null.
